features.note: No regression at 30% travel: top blade hoods forward showing its lit top skin, drive blade sweeps opposite with a bright curved face, bottom blade counter-tilts below; adjacent blades never read parallel. Counter-rotation survives this light rig.

No regression: plated stub clearly protrudes from the frame right face before the black U-clamp; orange body hangs on the shaft, never flush; anti-rotation strap drops to a frame foot. Weakness is compositional, not structural: the actuator sits tight against the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel corner and its cable is clipped behind it, undercutting the hero-side read.

Dial bezel, printed face and bold pointer remain visible on the actuator head and the pointer angle stays consistent with 30% travel. At this frame size the arc printing is not resolvable — the gauge still reads by bezel/pointer shape. Marginal but above threshold; no regression from surface.

No regression: real ~0.13 m channel depth, flange plates on both faces with discrete fasteners, visible wall thickness. Galv mottle breaks up the flats and the key models the front/side plane change cleanly.

No regression: bright plated tie rod with three crank blocks on the left (non-actuator) side, middle block opposed to top/bottom, spacing consistent with 30% travel. The rod picks up a useful edge highlight against the dark background; the crank blocks themselves sit dim.

important_features.note: Lower blade-edge and jamb strips still read as discrete matte near-black bulbs. The upper interior jamb seal and top blade underside remain merged into shadow — the fill correction deferred to this pass is not visible in the render.
Structured printed plate (header, model line, spec rows, barcode) survives this lighting without blowing out or falling into shadow; reads as a factory label at natural scale.

A dark cable exits below the actuator but is almost immediately clipped by the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel and vanishes against the near-black lower right; the catenary read depends on prior knowledge more than on pixels at this camera.

defects: Carried defect NOT resolved (was explicitly deferred to this pass): the upper interior of the opening is still the darkest zone — the band between the top blade and the drive blade crushes to near-black, and the top blade underside / upper jamb seal separate from shadow only marginally. No visible secondary fill or env lift on the upper interior.

Carried defect NOT resolved: the drive blade still reads roughly one value family brighter than the frame sharing galv_steel — a broad near-white specular sweep with a single soft dark band, bordering on blown at its hottest streak, against a mid-grey frame. Blade and frame do not yet read as the same galvanized family.

No contact shadow or readable ground plane: the damper floats in a dark navy void; nothing grounds the piece, and the lower third of the frame dissolves into the background instead of sitting on a surface.

Fog/background is a flat dark gradient, not a depth cue: there is no atmospheric separation between the near flange and the far flange or between object and void; depth is carried entirely by geometry, not by the rig.

Composition: the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel crowds the hero (actuator) corner — it abuts the orange body and clips the cable drop, eating the breathing room on the exact side the spec designates as hero. Diagonal grammar is present but mild; the piece reads close to frontal-flat at az42/elev24.
Evidence hygiene: the HUD caption still reads 'Pase materiales' on a lighting-camera capture — stale pass label on the gate evidence.
Single-view ambiguity (per gate contract): one neutral view only, no grazing/reference-match companions in this attempt; all scores capped at 0.85.
corrections: Apply the deferred fix for real: add a faint upward fill (or raise env/hemisphere contribution on the interior) so the top blade underside, upper interior and upper jamb seal read without inspection — target the upper interior band at a clearly-above-black value while keeping the EPDM seals darkest.

Pull the drive blade into the frame's galv value family: reduce the key/env specular energy on the blade or give it structured reflection content so its midtone sits within about one stop of the frame face, and tame the hottest streak so nothing approaches clipping.
Ground the piece: add a soft contact shadow (shadow-catcher plane or baked AO blob) under the frame so the damper sits on a surface instead of floating in the void.
Use fog/background as a depth cue: introduce a subtle floor-to-void gradient or gentle depth fog so the far flange and background separate from the near structure without washing the scene.

Recover hero-side breathing room: shift or shrink the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel (or bias the framing slightly left) so the actuator and its cable drop clear the UI; the cable catenary must be visible to the floor.
Update the HUD caption to the lighting-camera pass label so gate evidence matches the pass under review.
